scope: Only the 29 applied changes in english-bank-pcm-0660-0859-rules-0080-0134-patches.json; previous source holds 763,791,843 unchanged and not cleared.
reviewType: Independent AI semantic delta review, not native-speaker/teacher approval.

records.source: 그녀는 이번 주에 매일 도시락을 가져왔어요.

contexts.englishTarget: She has brought her own lunch every day this week.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 그녀는 이번 주에 매일 도시락을 가져왔어요.
contexts.rule: bring-brought-brought. 불규칙 동사이므로 -ed를 붙이지 않아요.

records.translation: She don bring her own lunch box every day dis week.
records.reason: Own lunch box now binds female subject as lunch owner, every day this week unchanged.

records.source: 그는 게임에 돈을 다 써 버렸어요.

contexts.englishTarget: He has spent all his money on games.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 그는 게임에 돈을 다 써 버렸어요.
contexts.rule: spend-spent-spent. spended라는 형태는 없어요.

records.translation: E don spend all im money for game.
records.reason: All im money binds subject as owner without changing totality or completed spending on games.

records.source: 유리는 펜팔 친구를 두 번 만난 적이 있어요.

contexts.englishTarget: Yuri has met her pen pal twice.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 유리는 펜팔 친구를 두 번 만난 적이 있어요.
contexts.rule: meet-met-met. 경험을 나타내는 현재완료에 과거분사 met을 써요.

records.translation: Yuri don meet Yuri own pen pal two time.
records.reason: Yuri own pen pal binds relationship to Yuri; repeated name avoids inferring female from reference her.

records.source: 내가 도착했을 때 방이 청소되고 있었어요.

contexts.englishTarget: The room was being cleaned when I arrived.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 내가 도착했을 때 방이 청소되고 있었어요.
contexts.rule: 과거진행형 수동태는 was/were + being + 과거분사예요.

records.translation: Dem bin dey clean di room when I arrive.
records.reason: Bin dey clean now gives explicit past-progressive frame at speaker arrival.

records.source: 아기는 그 노래를 듣자 울음을 멈췄어요.

contexts.englishTarget: The baby stopped crying when she heard the song.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 아기는 그 노래를 듣자 울음을 멈췄어요.
contexts.rule: stop + V-ing는 '~하던 것을 멈추다(중단)'라는 뜻이에요.

records.translation: Di baby no cry again after di baby hear di song.
records.reason: No cry again after hearing song clearly stops prior crying; baby sex stays unknown despite English she.

records.source: 내 형은 숙제를 도와주겠다고 약속했어요.

contexts.englishTarget: My brother promised to help me with homework.
contexts.rule: promise는 to부정사를 목적어로 취해요.

records.translation: My elder brother promise to help me with homework.
records.reason: Help me restores speaker beneficiary; elder brother and promise unchanged.

records.source: 엄마는 나에게 방을 청소하라고 말씀하셨어요.

contexts.englishTarget: My mom told me to clean my room.
contexts.rule: tell + 목적어 + to V: '~에게 ...하라고 말하다'.

records.translation: Mama tell me to clean my room.
records.reason: My room restores speaker ownership and mother instructing speaker.

records.source: 준은 금요일까지 프로젝트를 끝내야 해요.

contexts.englishTarget: Jun needs to finish his project by Friday.
contexts.rule: need는 to부정사를 목적어로 취해요. 주어가 3인칭 단수이면 needs가 돼요.

records.translation: Jun need finish Jun own project by Friday.
records.reason: Jun own project explicitly binds owner without inferring gender from English his.

records.source: 내 여동생은 계속 열쇠를 잃어버려요.

contexts.englishTarget: My sister keeps losing her keys.
contexts.rule: keep + V-ing는 '계속 ~하다'라는 뜻이에요.

records.translation: My younger sister dey lose her own key again and again.
records.reason: Her own keys binds explicit younger sister as repeated loser and owner.

records.source: 나는 일찍 일어나는 것에 익숙해요.

contexts.englishTarget: I'm used to getting up early.
contexts.rule: be used to + V-ing는 '~하는 데 익숙하다'라는 뜻이고, 이때 to는 전치사예요.

records.translation: To wake early don become normal for me.
records.reason: Wake early becoming normal for me expresses habituation rather than an English-form used to borrowing.

records.source: 그녀는 무슨 말을 해야 할지 몰랐어요.

contexts.englishTarget: She didn't know what to say.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 그녀는 무슨 말을 해야 할지 몰랐어요.
contexts.rule: what + to V는 '무엇을 ~할지'라는 뜻의 명사구예요.

records.translation: She no bin know wetin to talk.
records.reason: No bin know retains past negative knowledge and unspecified thing to say.

records.source: 금요일은 내 한 주에서 가장 바쁜 날이었어요.

contexts.englishTarget: Friday was the busiest day of my week.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 금요일은 내 한 주에서 가장 바쁜 날이었어요.
contexts.rule: y를 i로 바꾸고 -est를 붙이며(busy → busiest), 최상급 앞에는 the를 써요.

records.translation: Friday bin be di busiest day for my week.
records.reason: Bin be anchors busiest Friday within speaker’s week in past.

records.source: 민지는 오빠보다 영어를 더 잘해요.

contexts.englishTarget: Minji speaks English better than her brother.
contexts.rule: good/well의 비교급은 불규칙 형태인 better예요 (good - better - best).

records.translation: Minji sabi speak English pass Minji own elder brother.
records.reason: Minji own elder brother restores kinship referent with no name-based gender inference.

records.source: 그것은 올해 최악의 폭풍이었어요.

contexts.englishTarget: That was the worst storm of the year.
contexts.rule: bad의 최상급은 worst예요 (bad - worse - worst).

records.translation: Dat bin be di worst storm for di year.
records.reason: Bin be restores past worst-storm evaluation within the year.

records.source: 지호는 반에서 가장 빠른 달리기 선수예요.

contexts.englishTarget: Jiho is the fastest runner in his class.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 지호는 반에서 가장 빠른 달리기 선수예요.
contexts.rule: 최상급 뒤에는 범위를 나타내는 in(집단·장소)을 쓰고, than은 쓰지 않아요.

records.translation: Jiho na di fastest runner for Jiho own class.
records.reason: Jiho own class binds school comparison group, no male inference from name.

records.source: 소라는 친구들보다 더 일찍 도착해요.

contexts.englishTarget: Sora arrives earlier than her friends.
contexts.rule: early는 y를 i로 바꿔 earlier/earliest가 돼요. 부사 early도 같은 방식이에요.

records.translation: Sora dey arrive earlier pass Sora own friend dem.
records.reason: Sora own friends restores comparison relation without assigning Sora sex.

records.source: 비가 왔지만 우리는 밖에서 놀았다.

contexts.englishTarget: Although it was raining, we played outside.
contexts.rule: Although는 ‘~이지만’이라는 양보의 접속사이고, 같은 문장에서 but과 함께 쓰지 않아요.

records.translation: Even though rain bin dey fall, we play outside.
records.reason: Bin dey fall gives past rain frame; outside play despite rain unchanged.

records.source: 내가 빌린 책은 아주 재미있었다.

contexts.englishTarget: The book that I borrowed was very interesting.
contexts.rule: 사물을 꾸미는 관계대명사는 that이나 which를 써요. who는 사람에게 쓰고, 관계대명사가 목적어 역할을 하면 it을 따로 쓰지 않아요.

records.translation: Di book wey I borrow bin interesting well-well.
records.reason: Bin anchors interesting evaluation of speaker’s borrowed book in past.

records.source: 너무 추워서 우리는 집에 있었다.

contexts.englishTarget: It was so cold that we stayed at home.
contexts.rule: ‘so + 형용사 + that ~’은 ‘너무 ~해서 …하다’라는 결과를 나타내요.

records.translation: Weather bin cold so much, so we stay house.
records.reason: Bin cold gives past excessive-cold cause of staying home.

records.source: 우산을 가져오는 것을 잊어서 비를 맞았다.

contexts.englishTarget: I forgot to bring my umbrella, so I got wet.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 우산을 가져오는 것을 잊어서 비를 맞았다.
contexts.rule: forget to-부정사는 ‘~할 것을 잊다’, forget -ing는 ‘~했던 것을 잊다’라는 뜻이에요.

records.translation: I forget to bring my umbrella, so rain wet me.
records.reason: My umbrella binds speaker ownership; forgetting to bring and wet result unchanged.

records.source: 그녀가 한 모든 말은 사실이었어요.

contexts.englishTarget: Everything that she said was true.
contexts.rule: everything, all, only 같은 말이 선행사일 때는 주로 that을 써요. 선행사가 이미 있으므로 what은 쓸 수 없어요.

records.translation: Everything wey she talk bin true.
records.reason: Bin true retains past truth of everything said by explicit female subject.

records.source: 내가 함께 춤춘 소녀는 미나였어요.

contexts.englishTarget: The girl with whom I danced was Mina.
contexts.rule: 전치사 바로 뒤에는 who나 that을 쓸 수 없고 사람이면 whom을 써요.

records.translation: Di girl wey I dance with bin be Mina.
records.reason: Bin be restores past identification of danced-with girl as Mina, explicit girl only within this row.

records.source: 내가 듣고 있던 노래는 내가 가장 좋아하는 곡이에요.

contexts.englishTarget: The song that I was listening to is my favorite.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 내가 듣고 있던 노래는 내가 가장 좋아하는 곡이에요.
contexts.rule: 전치사를 관계절 끝에 남겨 두면 그 전치사(listen to)를 빠뜨리면 안 돼요.

records.translation: Di song wey I bin dey listen to na di one wey I like pass all.
records.reason: Bin dey listen marks prior ongoing listening while current favorite-song assertion remains current.

records.source: 그는 시험에 합격했고, 그것이 부모님을 기쁘게 했어요.

contexts.englishTarget: He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 그는 시험에 합격했고, 그것이 부모님을 기쁘게 했어요.
contexts.rule: which는 앞 문장 전체를 받아 ‘그것이 ~했다’는 뜻으로 쓸 수 있어요. 쉼표 뒤에는 that을 쓰지 않아요.

records.translation: E pass di exam, and dat make im parent dem happy.
records.reason: Im parent dem binds exam passer’s parents; neutral im adds no inferred sex.

records.source: 우리가 어제 본 영화는 지루했어요.

contexts.englishTarget: The movie that we watched yesterday was boring.
contexts.rule: 목적격 관계대명사는 관계절 안에서 목적어 역할을 하므로 it 같은 목적어를 또 쓰지 않아요.

records.translation: Di film wey we watch yesterday bin boring.
records.reason: Bin boring restores past film evaluation, yesterday watching unchanged.

records.source: 할머니를 치료해 주신 의사 선생님은 아주 친절했어요.

contexts.englishTarget: The doctor who treated my grandmother was very kind.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 할머니를 치료해 주신 의사 선생님은 아주 친절했어요.
contexts.rule: 사람 선행사의 주격 관계대명사는 who예요. 전체 문장의 동사는 doctor(단수)에 맞춰 was를 써요.

records.translation: Di doctor wey treat my grandmama bin kind well-well.
records.reason: My grandmama and bin kind restore English speaker kinship and Korean past kind evaluation; doctor sex remains unknown.

records.source: A cat은 한 마리이므로 동사에 -s를 붙여 sits라고 해요. 'on the sofa'(소파 위에)는 덩어리로 같이 써요.

contexts.englishTarget: A cat sits on the sofa.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 고양이 한 마리가 소파 위에 앉아 있어요.
contexts.rule: A cat은 한 마리이므로 동사에 -s를 붙여 sits라고 해요. 'on the sofa'(소파 위에)는 덩어리로 같이 써요.

records.translation: A cat na one animal, so add -s and use sits. on the sofa mean on top sofa. Keep di English expression on the sofa together as one place expression.
records.reason: English on the sofa preserved as learning chunk, native on top sofa restores source meaning; cat singular and sits rule unchanged.

records.source: Mom and Dad는 두 사람이라서 동사에 -s를 붙이지 않아요. in the park(공원에서)는 문장 뒤쪽에 써요.

contexts.englishTarget: Mom and Dad walk in the park.
contexts.rule: Mom and Dad는 두 사람이라서 동사에 -s를 붙이지 않아요. in the park(공원에서)는 문장 뒤쪽에 써요.

records.translation: Mom and Dad na two person, so no add -s to verb. in the park mean inside di park. Put in the park near di end of di sentence.
records.reason: English in the park retained, inside di park restores place gloss; two parents and no -s rule unchanged.

records.source: can(~할 수 있다) 뒤에는 동사의 원래 모양을 써요. Tom이 한 명이어도 swims라고 하지 않아요.

contexts.englishTarget: Tom can swim fast.
contexts.rule: can(~할 수 있다) 뒤에는 동사의 원래 모양을 써요. Tom이 한 명이어도 swims라고 하지 않아요.

records.translation: can dey show say person fit do something. After can, use verb base form. Even though Tom na one person, no use swims after can.
records.reason: Person fit do something restores ability meaning of can; base-form rule and rejection of swims unchanged.
